newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 10.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Up to 17 German companies seek investments and joint ventures in the Gulf Arab states.
- Council of Saudi chambers of commerce expects the private sector to increase its role in the economies of the Gulf.
- Qatar's foreign minister says Qatar will not bring up any issue that might upset Bahrain at next Gulf Arab summit in Doha in December.
